{"inserts":["INSERT INTO public.users (id, email, name, country, status, created_at) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES (1, 'a@example.com', NULL, 'US', 'active', '2020-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz)","INSERT INTO public.orders (id, user_id, status, total_cents, created_at, updated_at) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES (1, 1, 'paid', 100, $3, $3), (2, 1, 'paid', 100, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz), (3, 1, 'paid', 100, '2100-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz, '2100-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz)","INSERT INTO public.products (id, sku, name, category, price_cents) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES (1, 'SKU-1', 'boundary match', $1, 100), (2, 'SKU-2', 'duplicate matches', $1, 100), (3, 'SKU-3', 'only failing items', $1, 100), (4, 'SKU-4', 'upper category', upper($1), 100), (5, 'SKU-5', 'trailing space category', $1 || ' ', 100), (6, 'SKU-6', 'no items', $1, 100), (7, 'SKU-7', 'lower category', lower($1), 100)","INSERT INTO public.line_items (id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_cents) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES (1, 1, 1, $4, 10), (2, 1, 2, $4, 10), (3, 3, 2, $4, 10), (4, 3, 2, $4, 10), (5, 1, 3, $4 - 1, 10), (6, 2, 3, $4, 10), (7, 3, 4, $4, 10), (8, 3, 5, $4, 10), (9, 1, 7, $4, 10), (10, 2, 1, $4 - 1, 10)"]}
